content: Màlye kan'kiir in'kɔl a Yɛsu may a usɔŋ
Ilä isyaam kusà a Pak mukwo, Yɛsu kàkyen Bɛtanya, kà ikal kàfakalà Lazar akwà kàwiiy nde uboo a akü.
Akun, Màlatà kun'pɛ isaa bun'lääm ba. Lazar kàkäl umwɛy uboo a baar bàkäl mbwo mwɛy anà Yɛsu mudyà u mɛsà.
Màlye kàwɛl boboo a litre mwɛy là may a usɔŋ màndandaa, màntal a mbɔɔn, nde kàsir ma kà in'kɔl a Yɛsu. Ungö waa kàkɔɔmà ma a ntswe ande. Apan, ndwà yanswà yàtiimà a usɔŋ a may.
Ungö apan, Yudasi Isikalyɔt - umwɛy uboo a alɔŋki ande, nde mbuur awayun'yälà, - kàtɛn naa:
« Ntɔn nkye mpa bàyälà ba may a usɔŋ amà unsà nkam tär yà itɛr a ngim, waa bàlàpà ya akà aŋàlàmbwà? »
Kàtɛɛnà nde abà, kà ntɔn nde kàkäl anà ngyɛb a aŋàlàmbwà anki, wɛɛ ntɔn nde kàkäl mbüüb: nde kàfakaarà bɔ̈ɔ̈n a ngim, waa kàfalwabà ngim bàsyee uboo mwo.
Apan, Yɛsu kàtɛn naa: « Un'si a duu! Kan'kyer nde abà, nde kan'tsweel kusà ntɔn ilä bàsan'dye.
Bɛ làwe anà aŋàlàmbwà ilä byanswà, wɛɛ mɛ, bɛ làbye anki anà mɛ ilä byanswà. »
Ndiirà ntɔn Lazar
Apan, un'sɛŋ a Ayudà mbɔɔn kàwem wa naa Yɛsu kàkäl u Bɛtanya, wa kàkyeenà kwo, kà nà ntɔn Yɛsu mpɛl anki, wɛɛ sye ntɔn mukàman Lazar akwà kàwiiy nde uboo a akü.
Apan, andweer a angaŋ bàdirà mudwa Lazar sye,
ntɔn Ayudà mbɔɔn bàtiinà Ikööŋ aba, waa bàsyee làkwikilà akà Yɛsu isin nà Lazar.
Yɛsu kan'bilà u Yɛlusàlɛm
U taaŋtye, iköŋ a baar mbɔɔn akwà bàyi un'kyɔm a Pak, kyàwem naa Yɛsu wàmuyàbeenà Yɛlusàlɛm.
Ba bàwɛl an'laaŋ a an'bà, bàkyen mukàbwey anà nde, bàmuyisà in'kwɛŋ naa: « Ɔsana! Wɛy ukäl aŋàsaak mbuur awà ayà kà ikɔb a Mwol, Mfum a Isàlɛl. »
Yɛsu kàmɛn mwan a anɛ, waa kàbwaay udu a wa, asànaa ikyäänà Ndaa Aŋàsɔn naa:

content.text: « Bul a Siyɔn, twon an'man bɔɔmà!
akyàbwaay udu a mwan a anɛ. »

content: U nsɛmà, alɔŋki ande bàkayöbà anki indiir abi. Wɛɛ umpal kàwɛl Yɛsu làkoo, apan ba bàyɔbà naa indiir abi bàsön ntɔn nde anà ba bya sye bàkyer ntɔn nde.
Baar banswà bàkäl anà Yɛsu mpal kàbel nde Lazar muyàtoo kà an'dii anà kun'wiiy nde uboo a akü, bun'tɛɛlà imbäl.
Kyakin, iköŋ a baar kyàkàbwey kya anà nde, ntɔn kya kyàwem naa nde kàkyer impà akin.
Apan, Amfarisi bàtɛn ba a ba naa: « Bɛ lan'man naa bɛ akà undiir làyàwal anki: le, baar banswà bàmun'lab! »
Angɛlɛki amwɛy bàmuleŋ Yɛsu
Yàmɛnà naa uboo a baar bàbeenà Yɛlusàlɛm mukömà umpal a un'kyɔm, bàkäl anà Angɛlɛki amwɛy.
Ba bàsin apà Filipo, un'nsi Bɛtesayidà a Ngalilɛ, waa bun'lɔ̈ɔ̈m naa: « Un'lɔɔŋ, bi ikwen muman Yɛsu. »
Filipo kàkàsam Andrɛ, ungö, ba bàbɔ̈ɔ̈l waa bàkàsam Yɛsu.
Yɛsu kafuur naa: « Mpalabà taaŋ lan'kwo alà uwal Mwan a mbuur làkoo.
Ndandaa, ndandaa, mɛ alàkyään, isàkal naa imbɛŋ a blɛ kyan'bwà u mɛɛn ikü anki, kya ikal kya mpɛl aŋàyen. Wɛɛ, isàkal naa kya kyan'kwà, kya ibɔr mbɛŋ mbɔɔn.
Mbuur akwen mɔ̈ɔ̈ ande aŋàsɔ̈ɔ̈n Nzam, wa akyà bwà, wɛɛ mbuur asàkɔɔb mɔ̈ɔ̈ ande u mɛɛn pà, nde asàkaar wa mbul a in'tye.
Isàkal naa mbuur kan'kwen mukan'syääl, wɛy nde kan'läb. Ikal in'wà mɛ, un'syääl amɛ asàkal kwo sye. Isàkal naa mbuur kàman'syääl, Taa asun'pà làkoo.
Yɛsu kan'sam nkweel ande
« Papanà mpem amɛ yan'too! Waa ininà mɛ in'tɛn? Taa, ntsü mɔ̈ɔ̈ utaaŋ alà? Wɛɛ kiin amɛ, mɛ kàyi ntɔn taaŋ a mpay a tub alà!
Taa, pà ikɔb angye làkoo! » Apan, ndaa yàfü du, yàtɛn naa: « Mɛ kàkyàpà kya làkoo, mɛ in'kyer ayàfàpà kya làkoo. »
Iköŋ a baar kyàkäl pa anà kyàwem ndaa, kyàtɛɛnà naa: « Ipar kyan'bwà! » Bumwɛy naa: « Un'kyeey mwɛy kàmusam! »
Yɛsu kakyään naa: « Ndaa ayi kà ban'tɛn a mɛ anki, wɛɛ ban'tɛn a bɛ.
Papanà là taaŋ mutsul nsaŋ a mɛɛn mà, papanà mfum a mɛɛn mà bàyun'tɔɔm u nsà.
Wɛɛ akà mɛ, mpal bàsan'sɛɛn u mɛɛn pà, mɛ in'sànaan baar banswà akà mɛ. »
Kàtɛɛnà nde abà, nde kàswɛŋà naa nkweel ande isàkal aben.
Iköŋ a baar kyun'fuur naa: « Bi, bi kàlɔŋàkà unsà Un'kɔɔn naa Klistɔ asàkal anà mɔ̈ɔ̈ ipepey. Aben ngye an'kwo mutɛn naa Mwan a mbuur bàkyer asun'sɛɛn? Nà Mwan a mbuur awà? »

Yɛsu kàtɛn a ba naa: « Pɛɛlà làfàkal anki anà taaŋ mbɔɔn uboo a bɛ. Làlyaaŋ umpal làbà bɛ anà pɛɛlà, ntɔn mpib ikɔ̈ɔ̈n alabweel. Ntɔn mbuur afilyaaŋ u mpib, nde uyöb anki naa nde akyà ken.

Kyakin, mpal làbà bɛ anà pɛɛlà, làsi làkwikilà amu pɛɛlà, ntɔn bɛ làbulà baan a pɛɛlà. » Ayudà ban'tɔn musà làkwikilà amu Yɛsu Ungö kàsam nde ba abà, Yɛsu kàlwomà paa, waa kàkàyee ukwɛl apà ba.
Itàkal naa nde kàkyerà idiim mbɔɔn u mii a ba, ba bàsun'sà anki làkwikilà.
Abun yàkwe ndaa kàtɛn ŋangɔɔm Yɛsay:

content.text: « Mwol, nà kàsi làkwikilà akà an'lɔɔŋ abi?
Mwol ngwal ande kàswɛŋ akà nà? »

content: Yɛsay awà kàswɛŋ sye isin a ndaa mpa bàkwe ba musà làkwikilà:

content.text: ntɔn ba bàkɔ̈ɔ̈n asàfyefurà akà mɛ

content: Yɛsay kàtɛn nde indiir abi, ntɔn kàmɛn nde làkoo a Yɛsu, waa kàsam ntɔn nde.
Apanà sye, bàmbɔɔn uboo a amfum a Ayudà ŋakwo bàsi làkwikilà amu nde. Wɛɛ, ntɔn Amfarisi, ba bàkyey anki u mii a baar manà bàyatwey u ndwà a nköŋ a Ayudà.
Ntɔn ba bàkwen làkoo lan'fà akà baar, akwànaa lan'fà akà Nzam.
Nsaŋ ntɔn ndaa a Yɛsu
Yɛsu kàsi un'kwɛŋ: « Mbuur asà làkwikilà amu mɛ, kà amu mɛ mpɛl anki nde kan'sà làkwikilà, wɛɛ amu mbuur kan'töm sye.
Mbuur aman'man, nde kan'man sye mbuur kan'töm.
Mɛ pɛɛlà, mɛ kàyi u mɛɛn, ntɔn mbuur wanswà asà làkwikilà amu mɛ, ukɔ̈ɔ̈n akal uboo a mpib.
Isàkal naa mbuur kan'wem ndaa amɛ, wɛ nde ya ufàsyääl anki, kà mɛ anki in'sàtsul nsaŋ ande, ntɔn mɛ kàyi anki mutsul nsaŋ a mɛɛn, wɛɛ ntɔn mukun'tswà mɔ̈ɔ̈.
Mbuur atɔn mɛ anà akɔ̈ɔ̈n akyey ndaa amɛ, nde we anà un'tsüül a nsaŋ ande: an'lɔɔŋ kàpɛɛ mɛ isun'tsüül mbar kà ilä a ntsüü.
Ntɔn mɛ kàtɛn anki unsà ukwen amɛ ŋakwo, wɛɛ Taa, mbuur kan'töm, kan'swɛŋ nde ŋakwo naa ininà mɛ in'tɛn, ininà mɛ in'kyään.
Waa mɛ in'kyàyöb naa nswɛɛŋ ande ifàpà mɔ̈ɔ̈ a mbul a in'tye. Kyakin indiir an'tɛn mɛ, mɛ bya an'tɛn asànaa kan'swɛŋ Taa. »
